# Pi Agent Replicate 1.4.0

First npm release of Pi Agent Replicate under its own package name.

## Highlights

- Give a Pi agent a `replicate` tool to work on independent tasks in parallel while it continues its own work. Replica results return to the originating session.
- Use separate Git worktrees by default, or select a shared project directory with `/replica-directory` when replicas need the same files and dependencies.
- Recover replica ownership and results across reloads, with durable settlement and cleanup after descendant work drains.
- Expose the subagent tree through the package-root API for programmatic integrations.
- Introduce the Pi Agent Replicate mascot and refreshed README.

Shared-directory changes are immediately visible and are not automatically rolled back if a replica fails. Coordinate concurrent edits to avoid overwriting work.
